# Следующая цепь B299-B310 — после B298

experience -> plasticity -> policy -> repeated preference -> trait trajectory.

## B300 — Neural Reality Gate v2
Для всех новых neural subsystems: input effect, lesion effect, persistence, transfer.

## B301 — Learned Self-Dynamics
Self-model должен быть learned representation, а не набором explicit fields.

## B302 — Agency Posterior
Модель должна оценивать собственную причинную долю в outcome.

## B303 — Motivation-to-Policy Causality
Curiosity/attachment/stress/homeostasis должны менять action distribution и проходить lesion tests.

## B305 — Dream/Replay Causality
Сон должен менять subsequent waking policy; confidence variation сама по себе недостаточна.

## B306 — Longitudinal Personality Benchmark
7/30/90-day-style replay with trajectory-level metrics.

## B307 — Action Ownership Refactor
Перевести action scoring from implicit mutation chain to explicit provenance DAG.

## B308 — Structural Plasticity v2
Ограниченная безопасная topology mutation при доказанной utility.

## B309 — Android Device Reality Gate
Termux, RAM, thermal, battery, kill/restart, offline mode.

## B310 — Independent Red-Team Audit
